## Houston 1.0.3

### What's new

- **Use your AI Employees from other apps.** Settings has API keys again, and each AI Employee has an API access page with its ID. Houston can also create a key for you right in the chat.
- **A heads-up before Claude signs you out.** Claude's sign-in ends about every four weeks. Houston now warns you a few days before and shows where to reconnect, so your routines keep running.
- **New AI Employees are ready in seconds.** Their first day shows up the moment you create them, and you can start it right away.
- **Empty folders show in the sidebar**, and it's clear where each folder ends.

### Fixes and polish

- **Replies stream reliably**, even when the connection catches up late.
- **A message you send while your AI Employee is still answering is never lost.** It waits and goes out when the reply ends.
- **A reply that stalls recovers on its own**, and a reply stuck repeating itself now stops.
- **The effort level you pick is used on every message.**
- **A routine run that couldn't start says why**, in your language.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
